coverage.method: Director compensation tables from every definitive proxy filed 2019-2026 (DEF 14A 2019-04-05, 2020-04-06, 2021-04-07, 2022-04-04, 2023-04-04, 2024-04-08, 2025-04-07, 2026-04-06), one calendar-year table per fiscal year FY2018-FY2025: 87 rows (12, 11, 12, 9, 10, 11, 11, 11). Every table has four columns: Fees earned or paid in cash, Stock award (the annual January DSU grant), Other fees earned or paid in cash (Bank board, Specific Purpose Committee meeting fees, J.P. Morgan Securities plc board, commemorative items), and Total. The other-fees column is recorded in all_other; option, non-equity incentive and pension/NQDC are 0. Every row's three columns sum to its printed total. James Dimon, the only employee director, is not in the tables. The EDGAR submissions feed (all 51 pages, 2019-2026) shows no 10-K/A, PRE 14A or DEFR14A in the period. All 26 DEFA14As 2019-2026 were fetched and their text has no director pay table (notice-and-access notices, the 2019/2020 additional materials, and image-only supplemental slide decks). Rows parsed from sec_text output; each quote is the full printed row with footnote markers kept on the name.
